call_guidance.calendar_input: Date labels use the explicit question_calendar/candidate_calendar, default proleptic Gregorian. Read calendar_conversion and analysis_context.input_calendar/input_date before explaining normalized datetimes. Julian dates use CE Jan1 years; do not infer regional reforms, March25 years or historical LMT/LAT. With explicit noon hour origin, retain raw calendar labels and read clock_conversion.hour_origin_conversion for the final canonical wall date; validate range after nominal day carry.
call_guidance.clock_input: Use explicit question_clock_basis only from confirmed clock evidence: civil / local_mean_solar / local_apparent_solar. Solar bases must omit/null timezone_name; civil omission preserves the legacy +08:00 default, not evidence of a known zone. Read clock_conversion with calendar_conversion: first normalize date labels, then resolve the declared clock to TT/UT1. Geocentric LAT is not a topocentric sundial reconstruction. Before1960 UTC-named carriers denote UT1 model labels. Never infer an original clock from ASC fit or outcome; numerical residual is not record accuracy.
call_guidance.hour_origin: Use question_hour_origin=noon only for confirmed noon-based clock-hour labels such as Lilly1647 pp30-31 ephemeris tables. Default midnight preserves modern labels. Noon0=same-date12:00; noon12..23=next-date00:00..11:00. Read clock_conversion.hour_origin_conversion, raw calendar date/clock, and canonical question_datetime together. Calendar-normalized_local_datetime is a raw hour label and can be null for an unrepresentable intermediate date rescued by the carry; final wall time is separate. This is not physical elapsed duration, a timezone/EOT/JD offset, a house-table coordinate, a regional reform or proof of LMT/LAT. Do not infer the author's convention from a fitted chart. Apply declared hour origin before civil zone/DST validation or solar-clock inversion.
call_guidance.interpretation_boundary: Use horary.verdict, reasoning and rule_profile with the actual moon.motion_basis. Never turn candidate=true, same_ruler, instantaneous applying or the legacy heuristic_verdict into a verified source judgement or event probability.
call_guidance.physical_epoch: 太阳时反解的有效时刻可能落在UTC闰秒。converted_utc可含23:59:60；按clock_conversion.utc_representation区分标签与datetime可表示性，计算使用原生TT/UT1。不能把不能解析datetime说成计算失败，也不能将秒60截断、平滑或移到次日；数值标签精度不代表实测钟时精度。
call_guidance.ut1_source: ut1_source默认swiss_delta_t；显式iers_c04使用固定IERS20 C04每日实测合成UT1，仅覆盖1962-01-01 00:00至2026-09-19 00:00 UTC，需要UT1的时刻超范围拒绝；地心TT黄经事件搜索不需要在试算时刻取得UT1，不因C04边界自动变成未知。读取clock_conversion.ut1_reference与calculation_basis.earth_rotation，区分已发布日值和TT上连续UT1-TAI线性插值。只应用UT1，未应用极移、CIP偏移或日内潮汐，形式标准差不是瞬时物理误差界；不得声称完整EOP、史料钟时精度或预测效力。

calendar_input.purpose: 核对显式儒略历／延伸格里历日期、转换后的本地钟时与实际TT/UT1；不推断地区改历、旧式年份或历史钟时，不把日期换算当原图复现。

clock_input.purpose: 核对已确认的民用／地方平太阳／地心视太阳钟时、历法转换次序及同一物理TT/UT1；未知原书钟时不拟合，数值残差不充当史料精度。

data_files.scope: Available when ephemeris_policy=require_data_files. Read the actual observed physical models, file sources, reference zeros and private-worker reports. Native event-internal reads, fixed-star catalogue formulae and absolute accuracy are not certified. This card does not set the input policy.

event_paths.purpose: Read actual seven-planet TT roots in the explicit ±30-day scan, distinct principal/principal and carrier/source prior contacts, all intervening carrier contacts, event-epoch receptions with numerical boundary uncertainty, and selected Lilly p111 prohibition/refranation patterns. Product radius and radical sect policies, unknown conditions, finite horizon, frame-specific station timing and incomplete whole-method acceptance remain explicit. A satisfied sequence subset is not a full judgement or outcome proof.
event_paths.when: 核对主星、传光星与聚光星的实际历史／未来事件顺序、停滞折返及不同事件历元的接纳。

hour_origin.purpose: 核对已确认的午夜／正午起算小时标签：原历法日期、原小时与进位后的标准钟面分别读取，再看实际TT／UT1；不推断原图口径，不当作时区修正或实际持续时长。

lilly_fortitudes.purpose: Read all41-row summary including inapplicable and unknown conditions. Daily displacement differs from instantaneous direction; dated stellar astrometry differs from printed1647 coordinates. Literal row sums do not reproduce every original worked total. Expand fortitudes.planets.<Planet>.rows for exact predicates; unknown rows are not zero, and points are not success probabilities or a complete judgement.
lilly_fortitudes.when: 逐行核对Lilly1647第115页本质／偶然尊贵表的已算条件、24小时运动与未知项。

lilly_fortune.purpose: Lilly pp143-144 uses physical ASC+Moon-Sun day and night. Keep geometric occupancy, nearest-cusp virtue and significator roles separate. The28 p145 rows include neutral Aries and Fortune-specific sixth/eighth-house weights. Exact planetary rays and p179 stellar range transfer are disclosed conventions. P180 beyond-five-degree assignment and row discrepancies remain failed controls; unknowns never equal zero; no wealth amount, success probability or complete judgement follows.
lilly_fortune.when: 核对Lilly1647福点昼夜同式、宫头五度效力归属和第145页独立强弱表。

lilly_orbs_houses.purpose: Read selected p107 full-orb column and declared equality convention; house is the significator role, occupied_house is actual chart occupancy. P48 rank assumes otherwise equal dignity; p115 house points are a separate partial row. P126-127 dwelling requires lunar transfer; finite ordered Moon contacts and current rays are necessary subconditions, not complete transfer, full judgement or reality proof. Preserve missing histories, collisions and numerical ambiguity.
lilly_orbs_houses.when: 核对Lilly1647第107页两列容许度、第48／115页宫位事实，以及第126–127页不可仅凭居宫断成的条件。

lilly_radicality.purpose: Read all12 clauses in the pp121-123 manual inventory, actual unequal-hour geometry, selected p104 triplicity and own-nature affinity, prerequisites, exceptions and attributed variants. The Moon late-degree cutoff is unspecified; no27degree threshold or p115 weighted balance0 is invented. Optional context is caller-reported only: a known question timestamp is not a certain timed event, and no age/appearance/strength is inferred. safe_to_judge remains null for the uncertified full method, not false/true reality prediction. Compute the supplied instant without changing it to clear a caution.
lilly_radicality.when: 核对Lilly1647起盘审慎条件、时主对应、原文例外与未知定义，避免仅凭上升度数认定整盘可判断。

lilly_reception_conditions.purpose: Selected Lilly1647 seven-planet dignity/reception table and p125-126 route conditions, including actual finite event sequences in event_paths. Preserve receiver/guest direction, radical chart sect, event epochs, explicit numerical boundary ambiguity and selected p107 orb column, literal occupied-house facts and incomplete full house/epoch interpretation. Sidereal is an extension, not original-edition acceptance.
lilly_reception_conditions.when: 核对Lilly1647指定版本的本质尊贵、谁接纳谁、互纳与第125–126页路径的逐项条件；同时读取七曜原始状态与未核验项。

lilly_sign_rays.purpose: Caster-to-receiver direction from Lilly1647 pp108-109, separate from reception host/guest and Hellenistic overcoming. Preserve the32printed ordered inconjunct pairs and16pairs absent from both tables. Same-sign co-presence does not establish bodily conjunction. Compare the sign table to the selected degree/orb candidate without replacing it, adding strength points or certifying event perfection. Sidereal is an extension.
lilly_sign_rays.when: 核对Lilly1647第108–109页由求问者主星向所问主星发出的左相／右相、冲相、同星座和原表不相照关系，并与实际度数相位候选分别核对。

motion_conditions.purpose: Read actual lunar before-ingress and finite seven-planet TT event histories, nominal geometry, selected Lilly receptions and event-path conditions separately. Physical roots and named source predicates do not establish a complete source-method judgement; native failure and unsearched times remain unknown.
motion_conditions.when: 用户按明确提问时刻询问卜卦相位与传统条件；先读实际月亮事件、候选路径与未核验条件，原型规则倾向不能当作完整Lilly判断。

physical_epoch.description: 输入钟时、原生TT/UT1及UTC显示标签；太阳时物理轴保留秒60。普通civil分支utc_representation可为null，未宣称原始资料或实测EOP已认证。

reference_points.purpose: Read declared body/system centers and actual physical model summary separately from analytical nodes; inspect native speed and applied source-derived/display-frame corrections. Root brackets are numerical resolution. Matched-reference-point validation is not body-center accuracy, full original method or reality prediction certification. Unavailable event histories remain explicit; empty events do not establish absence.
reference_points.when: 核对星历采用本体中心还是行星系统质心、物理后端与交点模型、以及成相／停滞所用日速来源。

solar_position_model.purpose: Read nominal-epoch finite unbent-ray geometry and the inspected native solar mass model. A background solar-disc position is a virtual continuous extension; foreground transits differ. Unknown geometry remains unknown. This is not an optical occultation, limb-contact, detectability or physical-error certificate. Never replace native positions with a no-deflection diagnostic to pass a reference comparison.
solar_position_model.when: 核对近太阳位置的原生偏折模型、太阳后方的虚拟模型视位置与太阳前方的凌日几何。

ut1_input.purpose: 核对明确选择的模型或IERS20 C04 UT1来源、固定覆盖期、源文件名称与版本、插值区间与未应用修正；盘面与地平计算仍要求覆盖内UT1；地心TT黄经事件不外推UT1即可跨边界搜索，未取得瞬时观测误差或现实预测证据。

as_of.description: Freeze implicit current time: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone

category.description: Question topic, selecting the quesited house: general/wealth/family/property/marriage/lawsuit/theft/travel/career/hope/enemy; 生死、疾病与生育临床判断不开放

compact.description: 紧凑 JSON 输出（无缩进）；设为 false 则美化缩进。默认 true。

ephemeris_policy.description: auto retains and reports actual available models. require_data_files rejects analytical/orbital fallback for observed physical coordinates throughout the request, including clocks and samples; checks data contexts and endpoint hashes. Native rise/set query/result epochs are probed, but internal solver reads are not fully observable. Analytical points, fictitious elements, reference zeros and Earth rotation are separate; this is not an astronomical-accuracy or prediction certificate.

fields.description: 仅返回选定字段以节省 token：接受顶层键（如 'snapshot_text'）或点路径子字段（如 'bazi_birth.day_master'）。run_metadata 始终保留；留空请求全部字段，超出响应字符预算的部分由 result_delivery 保留供读取。无效路径默认附 projection_warnings；strict_fields=true 时拒绝。

house_system.description: House system, any convention (SE letter / key / integer code 0..8); Regiomontanus (R, code 2) is traditional for horary. Explicit values must be supported letters/names or integer codes0..8; unknown, blank, boolean and floating-point selections are rejected without substitution. Gauquelin (G) has36 clockwise sectors and is unavailable here.

include_snapshot_text.description: 是否包含人类可读的 snapshot_text 文本段（默认随工具而定）；设为 false 可显著减少返回的 token 数。

latitude.description: Latitude where the question was asked

longitude.description: Longitude where the question was asked

orb_profile.description: Lilly1647 p107 printed full-orb column. Both source variants are supported; pair radius is their half-sum. First column matches the printed Saturn/Venus moiety example.

parent_run_id.description: Parent call's run_id; correlation only, no stored execution lookup

question_calendar.description: Explicit calendar for question date labels; CE year starts Jan1. No country reform, March25 year rollover or historical clock inferred. Converted before the supplied timezone is applied.

question_clock_basis.description: Explicit question clock: civil zone clock, local mean solar (UT1 + east longitude/360), or geocentric local apparent solar (adds EOT). Do not infer an original author's clock by fitting the chart. Solar labels require timezone_name omitted/null.

question_hour_origin.description: Hour-label origin, independent of civil/LMT/LAT: midnight(default) hour0=00:00; noon hour0=same-date12:00 and hour12..23=next-date00:00..11:00. Select noon only for confirmed noon-based labels, e.g. Lilly1647 pp30-31 ephemeris tables, not all charts. Nominal labels, not elapsed duration, timezone or JD epoch correction. Calendar and day carry normalize before timezone validation.

anyOf.description: Optional caller reports for source exceptions, never inferred facts.

equal_fortune_infortune_testimonies_repo.description: Reported testimony balance; not derived from p115 weighted score0. All context reports are unverified and optional.

event_time_certain_reported.description: Caller reports a certain event instant; a valid date or known question time does not establish this.

figure_origin.description: Optional reported origin; timed_event only supplies context for the p122 exception, not a complete event-astrology method. Omission uses this API's question-instant convention.

radicality_context.description: Optional already-known reports for Lilly pp121-123 prerequisites and exceptions. Unknown reports remain unknown; do not infer age, appearance, affliction or event certainty to clear a caution.

response_char_limit.description: 完整 JSON 响应字符预算：0 不限制，或 4096–65536。MCP 默认 8192，REST/CLI 默认 0。超限不截断数据，返回 result_delivery 完整结果引用和可读取字段；按 manifest_uri 或字段分页读取原 run 的数据，不要重新计算或解析单页为完整文档。

strict_fields.description: 是否拒绝无效 fields 路径；默认 false，使用宽松投影并返回警告。

timezone_name.description: Civil question timezone (IANA or UTC offset). Omitted/null with civil preserves legacy +08:00; supply the known zone explicitly. Solar clock bases must omit/null this field to prevent double correction.

ut1_source.description: Earth-rotation time source: legacy Swiss Delta T model(default), or pinned IERS20 C04 final daily UT1 series,1962-01-01T00:00UTC..2026-09-19T00:00UTC. C04 uses continuous UT1-TAI interpolation; no out-of-range prediction/extrapolation/model fallback. Does not apply polar motion,CIP offsets or subdaily tides and does not certify clock-record precision. Geocentric TT longitude-event searches need no trial UT1; houses and horizon calculations still require covered UT1 epochs.

zodiac_type.description: Zodiac type, e.g. Tropic or Sidereal

comparison_requirements: 相同方法合同、实现与数据版本、选项及实际计算层
limitations: contract_v1是登记合同版本，不冒充上游原典或数值算法版本；实际版本另列runtime_method_ids
登记不认证全书、全部历史范围、连续区间稳定或现实预测
prerequisites: 请求Schema及领域前提必须成立；条件分支以本次实际回执为准
